end.summary:
Asha practised counting sides and corners of 2D shapes.
Ayaan counted triangle sides and corners, including when tilted.
Ayaan identified rectangles from four sides and four corners.
They answered 4 of 5 side-counting attempts unaided and 2 of 2 shape-naming attempts unaided.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners by tracing or looking at each shape, including shapes in different positions. Ayaan explained that a tilted triangle still has three sides and three corners; an earlier mix-up about the number changing was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Ayaan to find shapes around the room and count their sides and corners aloud.
